Marina —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the close. We can support repointing future invoices to HelioGrid Systems Inc and reissuing the two outstanding invoices, but there are a couple of standard items we need to confirm before we proceed: 

- Official proof of the legal entity change (certificate of merger or similar).
- A completed W-9 (for US tax records) or equivalent tax form if the entity is non-US.
- Confirmation of the effective cutover date (you listed 2027-01-01 — that works from our side).

Process options: for outstanding invoices we typically either:
- Issue a credit memo to the old invoice and generate new invoices to the new entity, or
- Reissue (void + resend) the original invoice number(s) under the new legal name (preferred by some customers for payment matching).

If you prefer reissue (same invoice numbers), we need signed confirmation from your AP that HelioGrid accepts the reissued numbers. If you prefer credit memos + new numbers, note that your AP will need to apply the credit when paying. Either way we can meet your 2026-11-27 target for preparing the drafts once we have the W-9 and merger confirmation.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Please send W-9 and merger certificate to billing@redwood.com (or attach here).
- Ben (cc'd) will confirm the remittance/bank routing details we will print on the invoice stub.
- I will create a short internal ticket and share draft reissued invoice stubs for your review by 2026-11-24.

I'll attach our internal invoice mapping template for reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
